d: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu shared his ambitious vision in a conversation with Palki Sharma, Founder, IGR, at the 31st CII Partnership Summit in Visakhapatnam. From attracting data centres and addressing global concerns over their water and resource consumption to creating jobs in the age of AI, Naidu outlined his plans for the state's future. He also spoke about India's potential to match or surpass China across multiple sectors, the future of manufacturing and his proposed Public-Private-People's Partnership (P4) model to make economic growth more inclusive.
